title: 第25章 皇城司第26章 小姐他昨晚没对你做什么吧
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
“咱们皇城司中绝对有鉴察院卧底，否则的话咱们这次绝对不会被打的如此狼狈，咱们这个身份已经不安全了，这次过后，该换个身份了！”
清雅冷声说道，
小莲也面色严肃，点了点头。
说完两人又看了一眼昏睡在床上的夏辰，小莲忍不住开口。
“小姐，接下来怎么做，直接施展幻术告知他一些线索吗？可就算他知道了线索，他会去查案吗？”
小莲有些担忧，关于谍探工作，基本上都是交由提灯人管理的，而夏辰只是一个禁军校尉，真的会有用吗？
“像他们这种功勋子弟，入官场肯定是想着立大功表现，从资料中显示，他入禁军绝对不是去混日子的，不管有没有效果，先试试吧，咱们必须要主动出击，不能被鉴察院的人牵着鼻子走了！”
清雅一边说着一边走到床边，她眼神宛如水波一般荡漾，一股奇异的能量蕴含在其中。
“我先拉他入梦境，在梦境潜移默化的影响他，让他明天去春花楼，春花楼会有一些线索被他发现，而这一切他都会认为是自己聪明过人，才能发现这些细节，但殊不知，自己已经成为了我们手中的刀！”
清雅脸上浮现出一抹微笑，若不是为了收集情报需要这个身份，她才不会让臭男人进入她的房间，至于让男人碰她身体，那就更不可能了。
不管是谁，一进入房间都会被她拉入梦境中，而这梦境无比真实，足以以假乱真，甚至可以影响人的一些思维想法等。
清雅全身有晶莹光芒覆盖，特别是眼眸中，有灵性光芒荡漾，有两只虚幻的蝴蝶从她眼眸中飞出，飘荡着飞入夏辰身体中。
但刚一进入，清雅的脸色一变，在他的视野范围中，突然看到了一双眸子正在俯视着她，高高在上，不带一丝感情，宛如神明。
而这双眼睛竟有四个瞳孔，仿佛蕴含了道与理，世间的终极奥义。
化为蝴蝶的清雅感觉自己的灵魂在颤栗，被冻结。
下一瞬间，那已经入侵夏辰识海中的两只幽蓝色蝴蝶破碎，一切镜花水月！
清雅睁开双眸，脸色苍白，眼神深处中还有惊恐之色，她刚想要后退。
但纤细葱白如玉的手臂被一只宽大的手掌牢牢抓住，巨大力量从手臂中传来，清雅站立不稳，直接往床上摔去。
等清雅反应过来时，发现自己已经躺在了夏辰的怀里，而夏辰正似笑非笑的看着她。
隐约间，清雅似乎看到了夏辰眼眶中有两个瞳孔合二为一，深邃的如同黑洞能够吞噬人心。

“放开我家小姐！”
这一惊变发生的太快了，等小莲反应过来时，发现自家小姐，脖颈已经被人掐住了。
但内心也深深不解，夏辰不是已经中了幻术，昏睡了过去吗？
美人在怀，温润如玉的触感，明明应该暧昧至极，但床榻上的两人此时都没有兴致继续深入交流下去。
content_en:
"There are definitely undercover agents from the Procuratorate in our Imperial City Department. Otherwise, we would never have been beaten so badly this time. Our identity is no longer safe. After this time, it's time to change our identity!"
Qingya said coldly,
Xiaolian also looked serious and nodded.
After saying that, the two of them glanced at Xia Chen, who was sleeping on the bed, and Xiaolian couldn't help but speak.
"Miss, what should I do next? Directly use illusions to tell him some clues? But even if he knows the clues, will he investigate the case?"
Xiaolian was a little worried. As for espionage work, it was basically left to the lantern holder, and Xia Chen was just a captain of the Imperial Army. Would it really be useful?
"Children with meritorious deeds like them must have entered the officialdom with the intention of making great achievements. From the information, it shows that he did not join the Forbidden Army just to hang around. Regardless of whether it works or not, let's try it first. We must take the initiative and not be led by the people of the Procuratorate!"
Qingya walked to the bed as she spoke, her eyes rippling like water waves, with a strange energy contained in them.
"I first pulled him into the dream, and influenced him subtly in the dream, asking him to go to Chunhua Tower tomorrow. Chunhua Tower will have some clues for him to discover, and he will think that he is so smart that he can discover these details, but little does he know that he has become a knife in our hands!"
A smile appeared on Qingya's face. If she didn't need this identity to collect intelligence, she would not let the smelly man enter her room. As for letting the man touch her body, it would be even more impossible.
No matter who it is, as soon as they enter the room, they will be pulled into a dream. This dream is so real that it can be confused with reality and can even affect some people's thinking.
Qingya's whole body was covered with crystal light, especially in her eyes, there was spiritual light rippling, and two illusory butterflies flew out of her eyes and floated into Xia Chen's body.
But as soon as he entered, Qing Ya's face changed. In his field of vision, he suddenly saw a pair of eyes looking down at her, high and devoid of any emotion, like gods.
And these eyes actually have four pupils, which seem to contain Tao and reason, the ultimate secret of the world.
Qingya, who turned into a butterfly, felt that her soul was trembling and frozen.
The next moment, the two blue butterflies that had invaded Xia Chen's sea of ​​consciousness were shattered, and everything was mirrored!
Qingya opened her eyes, her face was pale, and there was a look of fear deep in her eyes. She was about to retreat.
But the slender jade-white arm was firmly grasped by a wide palm, and huge force came from the arm. Qingya lost her balance and fell directly onto the bed.
When Qingya reacted, she found that she was already lying in Xia Chen's arms, and Xia Chen was looking at her with a half-smile.
Vaguely, Qingya seemed to see two pupils in Xia Chen's eyes that merged into one, as deep as a black hole that could swallow the human heart.
"Let go of my lady!"
This shocking change happened too fast. When Xiaolian reacted, she found that her young lady had been strangled by the neck.
But I was also deeply confused in my heart. Didn't Xia Chen fall into a phantom spell and fall into a coma?
The beauty in his arms, the gentle touch of jade, should obviously be extremely ambiguous, but at this time, the two people on the bed were not interested in continuing to communicate in depth.
